# GitHub Copilot repository instructions

Follow the canonical rules in [`../AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) and the detailed workflow in [`../docs/agent-playbook.md`](../docs/agent-playbook.md).

Key constraints: roadmap-driven work, evidence-first reverse engineering, exact binary/hash compatibility, fail-closed patching, reversible install/remove behavior, durable RE/experiment records, and explicit separation between synthetic validation and target-machine evidence.
